- We will issue a single PO referencing the amended private offer; can you confirm the exact wording we should include to avoid delays with our AP team?
- We need a short statement on data residency and SOC2 evidence for our security team (they might bundle the evidence with our purchase request).

Attaching our draft PO headers (PO_9342) and tax form.

Jared — thanks, and congrats on getting leadership sign-off. We can support the staged acceptance you outlined, with a couple of guardrails so the acceptance window maps to billing and usage reporting cleanly. Summary below: 

1) Acceptance sequencing
   - Canaries: Redwood will enable 50% reserved capacity on 2026-09-01 for 30 days as a canary.
   - Full ramp: Remaining 50% capacity will be enabled by 2026-10-15 assuming the canary shows no regressions and usage forecasts hold.

2) PO reference language (copy to paste into your PO): 
   "This Purchase Order (PO_9342) references the Redwood Inference Private Offer Amendment (ID: RWI-PO-2026-07-A1) and covers the 12-month term commencing 2026-09-01 with staged capacity acceptance as set forth in the Amendment."

3) Evidence & compliance
   - We'll attach a short SOC 2 attestation PDF and a data residency confirmation excerpt for your security team. We can also provide a dedicated evidence bundle (Doc link) if procurement wants the full pack.

4) Docs & signatures
   - I'll circulate an amended private offer (v2) for signature via DocuSign. Once we receive a countersigned DocuSign and your PO, we'll schedule the canary enablement window.

I've looped in Kimberly (legal) and Priyom (partner ops) to confirm the amendment language and billing alignment. Ben — can you confirm the billing/proration behavior when the second tranche turns on?

Thanks — target to have the DocuSign out by tomorrow EOD.

—Marissa
